comments.author: @DaveEtchells
comments.text:
The problem with going to “2 out of 10” is that bad actors won’t throttle back. 

China can’t get the most advanced chips, but they have essentially unlimited funds (at least until their economy and government completely collapse) and a lot of bright people themselves. We’ve been staying well ahead of them, but will we still, if we throttle back to 20%?

We need to do it safely, but the path to AGI/ASI is a lot like an arms race, simply for the amount of power that will come with its development. Given the current rapidly-exponentiating pace of development, the difference between first and second place will be orders of magnitude. We can’t afford to lose.
